result.title: Pixel as the Common Language: Unified Multimodal Embedding via Visual Rendering
result.summary: Multimodal embedding models map heterogeneous inputs into a shared representation space, yet text-only, image-only, and composed inputs are still presented in distinct formats and follow different routes through the model. This fragmentation prevents heterogeneous tasks from jointly optimizing the same end-to-end encoding process, limiting supervision transfer across input configurations. To address this issue, we propose unification before encoding and instantiate this paradigm in RenderEmbed. The framework uses Visual Substrate Rendering to convert heterogeneous inputs into a common visual substrate for encoding with a VLM. From the resulting visual tokens, Progressive Hierarchical Anchor Encoding produces compact retrieval representations by interleaving learnable anchors and fusing their states across layers, retaining broad context and fine-grained cues. Interventional Rendering Learning trains these representations to remain sensitive to content changes and stable across rendering variations through complementary semantic and rendering interventions. Extensive experiments on MMEB and ViDoRe v2, spanning diverse retrieval tasks, show that RenderEmbed outperforms prior state-of-the-art models at the same scale and exhibits strong out-of-domain generalization. Compared with MetaEmbed, RenderEmbed improves MMEB Overall Precision@1 by 1.7 points, with a larger 2.1-point gain on out-of-domain tasks. Transfer and scaling analyses further show that a shared visual pathway enables more effective learning from heterogeneous supervision.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RenderEmbed：先将文本、图像及组合输入统一渲染为视觉输入，由 VLM 编码，再用交错的可学习 anchor 跨层融合视觉 token 状态得到紧凑检索表示，并以干预式渲染训练增强内容敏感性与渲染不变性，在 MMEB、ViDoRe v2 上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 「先统一再编码」的视觉通路与跨层 anchor 汇聚 token 状态，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据保留与表示压缩的权衡提供借鉴线索；但其目标是检索嵌入，不涉及推理状态生成与停止决策，迁移价值需核查。
